item.title: Add currency parsing and CSV output to ledger
item.brief: Update the Rust TSV-to-CSV CLI to support an optional fourth TSV column containing an ISO 4217 currency code. Validate as exactly three uppercase ASCII letters; if missing, use USD. Emit CSV header date,account,amount_cents,currency and include currency on each row. A malformed currency code must print an error naming the 1-based input line to stderr and exit status 2; preserve status 1 for all other input errors. Update README. Keep existing tests passing and add or update focused tests for default USD, valid explicit currencies, malformed codes including line-number reporting and exit codes. Run cargo test. Commit the changes in this repository.
